# Add a configuration option

An option is defined in several places that are not generated from each other, and missing one is the usual mistake. Go through every step and say in the PR which ones you skipped and why.

## 1. Decide where it lives

- Component option, set as `<component>.<key>` in the config file, for example `block_cache.prefetch-on-open`: the options struct of that component, such as `BlockCacheOptions` in `component/block_cache/block_cache.go`.
- Mount-wide option such as `read-only` or `allow-other`: `mountOptions` in `cmd/mount.go`.

Use lowercase, hyphenated keys, with units in the name (`-mb`, `-sec`) as existing keys do.

## 2. Add the field

```go
PrefetchOnOpen bool `config:"prefetch-on-open" yaml:"prefetch-on-open,omitempty"`
```

Use the same key in the `config` and `yaml` tags; `config` is the one that is read.

## 3. Read and validate it in `Configure`

`Configure` reads all keys with `config.UnmarshalKey(compName, &conf)`. When the zero value is valid, use `config.IsSet(compName + ".<key>")` to tell "not set" from zero and apply the default constant. Return an error for invalid values, and add the effective value to the `log.Crit("<Component>::Configure : ...")` summary line near the end of `Configure`. It is logged at `log.Crit` so that it appears at the default `log_warning` level.

## 4. Add a CLI flag if users need it on the command line

In the component's `init()`, prefix the flag with the component name and bind it to the key:

```go
prefetchOnOpen := config.AddBoolFlag("block-cache-prefetch-on-open", false, "Start prefetching on open or wait for first read.")
config.BindPFlag(compName+".prefetch-on-open", prefetchOnOpen)
```

`cmd/mount.go` attaches these flags to `blobfuse2 mount` with `config.AttachToFlagSet`. The Markdown files in `doc/` are generated by `./blobfuse2 doc --output-location=./doc` but are out of date, so regenerating them changes unrelated files; regenerate only when asked.

## 5. Update `GenConfig` only if `blobfuse2 gen-config` should write the option

`GenConfig()` on the component writes the recommended config; most options are not in it.

## 6. Document it

- Add the key to the component's section of `setup/advancedConfig.yaml`, which is the reference for every option, in the existing style: `  prefetch-on-open: true|false <start prefetching on open instead of the first read. Default - false>`.
- Add it to `setup/baseConfig.yaml` only if most users need it.
- Add an entry under **Features** (or **Breaking Changes** for a changed default or a removed option) in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- The user documentation on Microsoft Learn is maintained elsewhere; say in the PR that it needs the new option.

## 7. Test it

In the component's test file, add tests that load a config string with `config.ReadConfigFromReader` and check the effective value when the option is set, the default when it is not, and the error for an invalid value. If the option changes behavior, test the behavior too.

## 8. Verify

```bash
make test PKG=./component/<component>
make build && ./blobfuse2 mount --help | grep -- '--<flag-name>'   # only if you added a flag
make verify
```

To check the option end to end without Azure, mount with it set as described in the [loopback-mount skill](../loopback-mount/SKILL.md).
